import pathlib,time,subprocess,json,hashlib,statistics

while True:
 log=(p/'validation-progress-retry.log').read_text() if (p/'validation-progress-retry.log').exists() else ''
 if 'Traceback' in log:raise RuntimeError('validation failed')
 if 'VALIDATION COMPLETE' in log and (p/'setup.json').exists():break
 time.sleep(2)
setup=json.loads((p/'setup.json').read_text())
for f,h in setup['source_sha256'].items():assert hashlib.sha256((root/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,f
# 最後の種別選択フォールバックも、最終ソースで通常・HTTP境界を追試する。
checks=[('final-targeted',['go','test','./internal/strictjson','./internal/postcapture','./internal/evidence','./internal/app','-timeout','600s']),('final-bootstrap',['go','test','./internal/bootstrap','-run','TestWebCSRFPostingAndRecovery|TestRepositoryPosting|TestRepositoryCloseDrainsPosting|TestPostingSharedWALDefaultAndDisable|TestPostingResourceBoundary','-timeout','600s']),('final-vet',['go','vet','./cmd/...','./internal/...','./tools/...']),('generated-check',['go','run','./tools/jsonencodegen','-check'])]
for name,cmd in checks:
 with (p/(name+'.log')).open('w') as f:subprocess.run(['mise','exec','--',*cmd],cwd=root,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
for mode in ['fixed','diagnostic']:
 subprocess.run(['mise','exec','--','python3',str(p/'run.py'),mode],cwd=root,check=True)
rows=json.loads((p/'trials.json').read_text())
for cpu in [1,2,4]:
 groups={v:[r['throughput'] for r in rows if r['kind']=='fixed' and r['cpus']==cpu and r['version']==v] for v in ['baseline','candidate']}
 if statistics.median(groups['candidate'])<statistics.median(groups['baseline'])*.98:

"""固定仕事量・診断・失敗を分け、再現用の入力と検査結果を公開記録へ集約する。"""
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import re
import statistics

p = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root = p.parents[1]
rows = json.loads((p / 'trials.json').read_text())
setup = json.loads((p / 'setup.json').read_text())
for name, expected in setup['source_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, name

summary = {}
for cpu in [1, 2, 4]:
    summary[str(cpu)] = {}
    for version in ['baseline', 'candidate']:
        group = [r for r in rows if r['kind'] == 'fixed' and r['cpus'] == cpu and r['version'] == version]
        summary[str(cpu)][version] = {
            'n': len(group),
            'median_posts_per_s': statistics.median(r['throughput'] for r in group),
            'range_posts_per_s': [min(r['throughput'] for r in group), max(r['throughput'] for r in group)],
            'median_cpu_ms_per_post': statistics.median(r['cpu_ms_per_success'] for r in group),
        }

micro = {}
for logfile in ['benchmark-final.log', 'schema-direct-benchmark.log', 'composite-benchmark.log']:
    groups = {}
    for line in (p / logfile).read_text().splitlines():
        m = re.match(r'(Benchmark\S+)-\d+\s+\d+\s+([\d.]+) ns/op\s+(\d+) B/op\s+(\d+) allocs/op', line)
        if m:
            groups.setdefault(m[1], []).append([float(m[2]), int(m[3]), int(m[4])])
    for key, samples in groups.items():
        micro[key] = {'samples': samples, 'median': [statistics.median(s[i] for s in samples) for i in range(3)]}

records = []
for row in rows:
    raw = json.loads((p / (row['name'] + '.json')).read_text())
    records.append({'trial': row, 'report': {k: v for k, v in raw.items() if k not in ['post_events', 'read_events', 'recovery_events', 'samples']},
                    'failed_posts': [e for e in raw['post_events'] if not e.get('ok')],
                    'raw_sha256': hashlib.sha256((p / (row['name'] + '.json')).read_bytes()).hexdigest()})

helpers = {}
for name in ['prepare.py', 'run.py', 'pipeline.py', 'validate.py', 'followup.py', 'analyze.py', 'report.py',
             'balanced120-probe.py', 'balanced120_capacity.py', 'idle-probe.py', 'idle_capacity.py', 'crash-probe.py', 'verify.py', 'render.mjs']:
    raw = (p / name).read_bytes()
    helpers[name] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'source': raw.decode()}
checks = {}
for name in ['full-normal.log', 'core-race.log', 'final-targeted.log', 'final-bootstrap.log', 'final-vet.log',
             'generated-check.log', 'final-schema-race.log', 'generate-check.log']:
    raw = (p / name).read_bytes()
    checks[name] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'output': raw.decode()}
for f in sorted(p.glob('fuzz-*.log')):
    checks[f.name] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'output': f.read_text()}
for name in ['verification.json', 'build-info.json']:
    if (p / name).exists():
        checks[name] = json.loads((p / name).read_text())
result = {'date': '2026-10-25', 'setup': setup, 'summary': summary, 'microbenchmarks': micro,
          'records': records, 'cpu_profiles': json.loads((p / 'cpu-shares.json').read_text()),
          'validation': json.loads((p / 'validation.json').read_text()), 'checks': checks,
          'crash': json.loads((p / 'candidate-crash-1g-2cpu.recovery.json').read_text()), 'helpers': helpers,
          'scope': 'isolated loopback TLS HTTP/1.1, fresh Docker volumes, shared SATA SSD. No production deployment or WAN/SLO proof.',
          'notes': ['baseline is stage A, not unoptimized HEAD; all ordinary trials retained',
                    'profiles include new custom encoders and validators; cumulative categories can overlap',
                    'idle and unprofiled diagnostic binary controls are separate from ordinary medians',

"""隔離HTTP投稿を固定予定・有界主体で発行し、完了処理量と未発行・拒否を分離する。"""
import collections
import subprocess
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import http.client
import re
import threading
import time

from probe_peak_mix import quantile, web_post


def summarize(events):
    """失敗を分位値から隠さず、成功数とHTTP時間・予定時刻基準の遅延を返す。"""
    sent = [row for row in events if not row.get("skipped")]
    return {"planned": len(events), "sent": len(sent),
            "success": sum(row.get("ok", False) for row in events),
            "acknowledged": sum(row.get("acknowledged", row.get("ok", False)) for row in events),
            "completion_errors_after_ack": sum(row.get("acknowledged", False) and not row.get("ok", False) for row in events),
            "errors": sum(not row.get("ok", False) for row in sent),
            "skipped": len(events) - len(sent),
            **{key + "_p95_ms": quantile([row[key + "_ms"] for row in sent if key + "_ms" in row], .95)
               for key in ("http", "scheduled", "issuance_wait")}}


def send_post(probe, kind, number, key, namespace):
    """専ブラ応答またはWebのフォーム・CSRF・303・遷移先を検証する。"""
    if kind == "web":
        return web_post(probe, number, key, namespace, verify_number=False)
    return probe.post(number, key, namespace, verify_number=False)[1]


def prepare(probe, args):
    """試験専用スレッドと確認済み主体を作り、準備投稿を測定区間から除く。"""
    keys, expected, prefixes = [], {}, {}
    for index in range(args.posting_capacity_threads):
        # スレ立てを一主体へ集中させず、準備中の連投拒否と本測定の処理能力を分ける。
        probe.actor(args.posting_capacity_workers + index)
        number = 900000 + index
        key, _ = probe.post(number, namespace="capacity-seed", verify_number=False)
        keys.append(key)
        expected[key] = [number]
        time.sleep(.1)
    actors = []
    for index in range(args.posting_capacity_workers):
        probe.actor(index)
        kind = "web" if index >= args.posting_capacity_workers * 2 // 3 else "legacy"
        number, key = 100000 + index, keys[index % len(keys)]
        send_post(probe, kind, number, key, "capacity-warm")
        expected[key].append(number)
        actors.append(probe.local.state)
        time.sleep(.025 if not args.waf else .1)
    for key in keys:
        status, headers, raw, _ = probe.request("GET", f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat", headers={"Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
        if status != 200 or headers.get("content-encoding"):
            raise RuntimeError("capacity seed DAT unavailable")
        prefixes[key] = raw
    return keys, expected, prefixes, actors


def prepare_reads(probe, args):
    """並行閲覧時だけ、従来と同じ実投稿1000レスの独立した全文fixtureを作る。"""
    if not args.posting_capacity_reads:
        return None
    key = ""
    started = time.monotonic()
    for number in range(1, 1001):
        probe.actor(number % 40)
        time.sleep(max(0, started + (number - 1) / args.prepare_post_rate - time.monotonic()))
        key, _ = probe.post(number, key, "capacity-read-fixture")
    status, _, raw, _ = probe.request("GET", f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat", headers={"Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
    if status != 200 or raw.count(b"\n") != 1001:
        raise RuntimeError("capacity read fixture mismatch")
    # 測定開始時に全圧縮表現を温め、冷却時の初回作成を比較へ混ぜない。
    from codec_probe_decode import decode
    for route in (f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat", f"/test/read.cgi/probe/{key}/l50"):
        status, headers, body, _ = probe.request("GET", route, headers={"Accept-Encoding": "gzip,identity;q=0"})
        if status != 200 or not decode(headers.get("content-encoding"), body):
            raise RuntimeError("capacity read warmup mismatch")
    return key, raw


def verify(probe, keys, expected, prefixes, posts):
    """全試行番号をDATで照合し、応答済み欠落・未応答保存・重複・旧版prefixを分ける。"""
    acknowledgements = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for row in posts:
        if row.get("acknowledged", row.get("ok")):
            acknowledgements[row["key"]].append(row["number"])
    checks = []
    read_deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
    for key in keys:
        attempts = 1
        status, headers, raw, _ = probe.request("GET", f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat", headers={"Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
        # 503は本文の破損ではなく未確認。負荷終了後の読取りだけ最大5秒待ち、拒否回数も残す。
        while status == 503 and time.monotonic() < read_deadline:
            time.sleep(.1)
            attempts += 1
            status, headers, raw, _ = probe.request("GET", f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat", headers={"Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
        if status != 200:
            checks.append({"key": key, "read_status": status, "read_attempts": attempts,
                           "available": False, "lines": None, "invalid_bodies": 0,
                           "missing_acknowledged": [], "stored_without_acknowledgement": [],
                           "duplicates": [], "prefix_ok": False, "sha256": None})
            continue
        numbers, invalid, invalid_names = [], 0, 0
        for line in raw.splitlines():
            fields = line.split(b"<>")
            if getattr(probe, "expected_trip", None) and probe.expected_trip not in fields[0]:
                invalid_names += 1
            body = fields[3].decode("cp932") if len(fields) == 5 else ""
            match = re.match(r"(?:ダミー返信 |Web混合負荷 \S+ )(\d+)\b", body)
            if match:
                numbers.append(int(match[1]))
            else:
                invalid += 1
        counts = collections.Counter(numbers)
        wanted = set(expected[key] + acknowledgements[key])
        checks.append({"key": key, "read_status": status, "read_attempts": attempts,
                       "available": True, "lines": len(numbers), "invalid_bodies": invalid,
                       "invalid_names": invalid_names,
                       "missing_acknowledged": sorted(wanted - counts.keys()),
                       "stored_without_acknowledgement": sorted(counts.keys() - wanted),
                       "duplicates": sorted(n for n, count in counts.items() if count != 1),
                       "prefix_ok": status == 200 and not headers.get("content-encoding") and raw.startswith(prefixes[key]),
                       "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
    ok = all(row["prefix_ok"] and not any(row[field] for field in
             ("invalid_bodies", "missing_acknowledged", "stored_without_acknowledgement", "duplicates")) and not row.get("invalid_names", 0) for row in checks)
    return {"ok": ok, "threads": checks, "unavailable_threads": sum(not row["available"] for row in checks),
            "read_retries": sum(row["read_attempts"] - 1 for row in checks), "read_retry_window_seconds": 5}


def valid_subject(status, headers, body, keys):
    """投稿と並行して変わる一覧も、全対象キー・重複・行形式・件数の範囲を照合する。"""
    if status != 200 or headers.get("content-encoding"):
        return False
    rows = body.splitlines()
    parsed = [re.fullmatch(rb"([0-9]+)\.dat<>(.+) \(([0-9]+)\)", row) for row in rows]
    if not rows or any(row is None for row in parsed):
        return False
    found = [row[1].decode("ascii") for row in parsed]
    return len(set(found)) == len(found) and set(keys) <= set(found) and all(1 <= int(row[3]) <= 1001 for row in parsed)


def measure(probe, args, counters):
    """指定秒数の固定到着率と5秒の回復を測り、サーバーcgroupと生成器CPUを分離する。"""
    fixture = prepare_reads(probe, args)
    keys, expected, prefixes, actors = prepare(probe, args)
    rate, seconds = args.posting_capacity_rate, args.posting_capacity_seconds
    workers, read_rate = args.posting_capacity_workers, args.posting_capacity_reads
    total = rate * seconds
    posts, reads, fatal = [], [], []
    begin = threading.Event()
    ready = threading.Barrier(workers + (40 if fixture else 0) + 1)
    started = 0

    def poster(worker):
        """主体ごとに一要求だけを実行し、追いつけない予定は未発行として記録する。"""
        probe.local.state = actors[worker]
        kind = "web" if worker >= workers * 2 // 3 else "legacy"
        indexes = [i for i in range(total) if (i % 5 == 4) == (kind == "web")]
        offset = worker - workers * 2 // 3 if kind == "web" else worker
        cohort = workers - workers * 2 // 3 if kind == "web" else workers * 2 // 3
        assigned = indexes[offset::cohort]
        ready.wait(timeout=30)
        begin.wait()
        for index in assigned:
            target = started + index / rate
            time.sleep(max(0, target - time.monotonic()))
            issued = time.monotonic()
            thread_index = index // 750 if args.posting_capacity_distribution == "rotate" else index % len(keys)
            key = keys[thread_index]
            row = {"index": index, "number": index + 1, "key": key, "kind": kind,
                   "planned_s": index / rate, "issued_s": issued - started}
            if not args.posting_capacity_fixed_count and issued >= target + workers / rate:
                posts.append({**row, "skipped": True, "ok": False})
                continue
            try:
                ms = send_post(probe, kind, index + 1, key, "capacity-measured")
                row.update({"ok": True, "http_ms": ms})
            except Exception as error:
                row.update({"ok": False, "error": type(error).__name__, "reason": str(error)[:700]})
            done = time.monotonic()
            row["acknowledged"] = row.get("ok", False) or any(stage.get("acknowledged", False) for stage in getattr(probe.local, "post_stages", []))
            row.update({"done_s": done - started, "scheduled_ms": (done - target) * 1000,
                        "issuance_wait_ms": max(0, issued - target) * 1000,
                        "stages": list(getattr(probe.local, "post_stages", []))})
            posts.append(row)

    def reader(worker):
        """専ブラ80%の無圧縮全文とWeb20%のgzipを、固定主体の一要求ずつで読む。"""
        key, raw = fixture
        kind = "legacy" if worker < 32 else "web"
        ready.wait(timeout=30)
        begin.wait()
        for index in range(worker, read_rate * seconds, 40):
            target = started + index / read_rate
            time.sleep(max(0, target - time.monotonic()))
            sample_kind = "subject" if getattr(args, "posting_capacity_subject_every", 0) and index % args.posting_capacity_subject_every == 0 else kind
            if time.monotonic() >= target + 40 / read_rate:
                reads.append({"kind": sample_kind, "ok": False, "skipped": True})
                continue
            try:
                path = f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat" if kind == "legacy" else f"/test/read.cgi/probe/{key}/l50"
                if sample_kind == "subject":
                    path = "/probe/subject.txt"
                code, headers, body, ms = probe.request("GET", path, headers={"Accept-Encoding": "identity" if sample_kind != "web" else "gzip,identity;q=0"})
                if sample_kind == "subject":
                    ok = valid_subject(code, headers, body, keys)
                elif kind == "legacy":
                    ok = code == 200 and not headers.get("content-encoding") and body == raw
                else:
                    from codec_probe_decode import decode
                    ok = code == 200 and headers.get("content-encoding") == "gzip" and b"<main" in decode(headers.get("content-encoding"), body)
                reads.append({"kind": sample_kind, "ok": ok, "bytes": len(body), "http_ms": ms,
                              "done_s": time.monotonic() - started})
            except Exception as error:
                reads.append({"kind": sample_kind, "ok": False, "error": type(error).__name__})

    def checked(function, worker):

"""隔離HTTP投稿を固定予定・有界主体で発行し、完了処理量と未発行・拒否を分離する。"""
import collections
import subprocess
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import http.client
import re
import threading
import time

from probe_peak_mix import quantile, web_post


def summarize(events):
    """失敗を分位値から隠さず、成功数とHTTP時間・予定時刻基準の遅延を返す。"""
    sent = [row for row in events if not row.get("skipped")]
    return {"planned": len(events), "sent": len(sent),
            "success": sum(row.get("ok", False) for row in events),
            "acknowledged": sum(row.get("acknowledged", row.get("ok", False)) for row in events),
            "completion_errors_after_ack": sum(row.get("acknowledged", False) and not row.get("ok", False) for row in events),
            "errors": sum(not row.get("ok", False) for row in sent),
            "skipped": len(events) - len(sent),
            **{key + "_p95_ms": quantile([row[key + "_ms"] for row in sent if key + "_ms" in row], .95)
               for key in ("http", "scheduled", "issuance_wait")}}


def send_post(probe, kind, number, key, namespace):
    """専ブラ応答またはWebのフォーム・CSRF・303・遷移先を検証する。"""
    if kind == "web":
        return web_post(probe, number, key, namespace, verify_number=False)
    return probe.post(number, key, namespace, verify_number=False)[1]


def prepare(probe, args):
    """試験専用スレッドと確認済み主体を作り、準備投稿を測定区間から除く。"""
    keys, expected, prefixes = [], {}, {}
    for index in range(args.posting_capacity_threads):
        # スレ立てを一主体へ集中させず、準備中の連投拒否と本測定の処理能力を分ける。
        probe.actor(args.posting_capacity_workers + index)
        number = 900000 + index
        key, _ = probe.post(number, namespace="capacity-seed", verify_number=False)
        keys.append(key)
        expected[key] = [number]
        time.sleep(.1)
    actors = []
    for index in range(args.posting_capacity_workers):
        probe.actor(index)
        kind = "web" if index >= args.posting_capacity_workers * 2 // 3 else "legacy"
        number, key = 100000 + index, keys[index % len(keys)]
        send_post(probe, kind, number, key, "capacity-warm")
        expected[key].append(number)
        actors.append(probe.local.state)
        time.sleep(.025 if not args.waf else .1)
    for key in keys:
        status, headers, raw, _ = probe.request("GET", f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat", headers={"Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
        if status != 200 or headers.get("content-encoding"):
            raise RuntimeError("capacity seed DAT unavailable")
        prefixes[key] = raw
    return keys, expected, prefixes, actors


def prepare_reads(probe, args):
    """並行閲覧時だけ、従来と同じ実投稿1000レスの独立した全文fixtureを作る。"""
    if not args.posting_capacity_reads:
        return None
    key = ""
    started = time.monotonic()
    for number in range(1, 1001):
        probe.actor(number % 40)
        time.sleep(max(0, started + (number - 1) / args.prepare_post_rate - time.monotonic()))
        key, _ = probe.post(number, key, "capacity-read-fixture")
    status, _, raw, _ = probe.request("GET", f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat", headers={"Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
    if status != 200 or raw.count(b"\n") != 1001:
        raise RuntimeError("capacity read fixture mismatch")
    # 測定開始時に全圧縮表現を温め、冷却時の初回作成を比較へ混ぜない。
    from codec_probe_decode import decode
    for route in (f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat", f"/test/read.cgi/probe/{key}/l50"):
        status, headers, body, _ = probe.request("GET", route, headers={"Accept-Encoding": "gzip,identity;q=0"})
        if status != 200 or not decode(headers.get("content-encoding"), body):
            raise RuntimeError("capacity read warmup mismatch")
    return key, raw


def verify(probe, keys, expected, prefixes, posts):
    """全試行番号をDATで照合し、応答済み欠落・未応答保存・重複・旧版prefixを分ける。"""
    acknowledgements = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for row in posts:
        if row.get("acknowledged", row.get("ok")):
            acknowledgements[row["key"]].append(row["number"])
    checks = []
    read_deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
    for key in keys:
        attempts = 1
        status, headers, raw, _ = probe.request("GET", f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat", headers={"Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
        # 503は本文の破損ではなく未確認。負荷終了後の読取りだけ最大5秒待ち、拒否回数も残す。
        while status == 503 and time.monotonic() < read_deadline:
            time.sleep(.1)
            attempts += 1
            status, headers, raw, _ = probe.request("GET", f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat", headers={"Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
        if status != 200:
            checks.append({"key": key, "read_status": status, "read_attempts": attempts,
                           "available": False, "lines": None, "invalid_bodies": 0,
                           "missing_acknowledged": [], "stored_without_acknowledgement": [],
                           "duplicates": [], "prefix_ok": False, "sha256": None})
            continue
        numbers, invalid, invalid_names = [], 0, 0
        for line in raw.splitlines():
            fields = line.split(b"<>")

                invalid_names += 1
            body = fields[3].decode("cp932") if len(fields) == 5 else ""

                       "available": True, "lines": len(numbers), "invalid_bodies": invalid,
                       "invalid_names": invalid_names,

                       "duplicates": sorted(n for n, count in counts.items() if count != 1),
                       "prefix_ok": status == 200 and not headers.get("content-encoding") and raw.startswith(prefixes[key]),
                       "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
    ok = all(row["prefix_ok"] and not any(row[field] for field in
             ("invalid_bodies", "missing_acknowledged", "stored_without_acknowledgement", "duplicates")) and not row.get("invalid_names", 0) for row in checks)
    return {"ok": ok, "threads": checks, "unavailable_threads": sum(not row["available"] for row in checks),
            "read_retries": sum(row["read_attempts"] - 1 for row in checks), "read_retry_window_seconds": 5}


def valid_subject(status, headers, body, keys):
    """投稿と並行して変わる一覧も、全対象キー・重複・行形式・件数の範囲を照合する。"""

    rows = body.splitlines()

def restart_and_verify(probe, keys, restart_server, timeout_seconds=60):
    """正常再起動後の全DATとETagを元byteで比較する。電源断やSIGKILLの検査ではない。"""
    snapshots = {}
    for key in keys:
        code, headers, body, _ = probe.request("GET", f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat", headers={"Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
        if code != 200 or not headers.get("etag") or headers.get("content-encoding"):
            raise RuntimeError("pre-restart DAT unavailable")
        snapshots[key] = headers["etag"], body
    started = time.monotonic()
    restart_server()
    probe.local = threading.local()
    ready = False
    while time.monotonic() - started < timeout_seconds:
        try:
            if probe.request("GET", "/")[0] == 200:
                ready = True
                break
        except (OSError, http.client.HTTPException):
            probe.local = threading.local()
        time.sleep(.1)
    ready_seconds = time.monotonic() - started
    checks = []
    if ready:
        for key, (etag, expected) in snapshots.items():
            code, headers, body, _ = probe.request("GET", f"/probe/dat/{key}.dat", headers={"Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
            checks.append({"key": key, "status": code, "body_equal": code == 200 and body == expected,
                           "etag_equal": headers.get("etag") == etag, "identity": not headers.get("content-encoding")})
    return {"ok": ready and all(row["body_equal"] and row["etag_equal"] and row["identity"] for row in checks),
            "mode": "graceful container restart on the same data volume", "ready": ready,
            "readiness_timeout_seconds": timeout_seconds, "ready_seconds": ready_seconds, "verification_seconds": time.monotonic() - started, "threads": checks}

import json
import pathlib
import subprocess

assert 'FOLLOWUP COMPLETE' in (p / 'followup.log').read_text()
setup = json.loads((p / 'setup.json').read_text())
changed = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-m', '-o', '--exclude-standard'], cwd=root, text=True).splitlines()
changed = {f for f in changed if f.endswith('.go') and f.startswith(('internal/', 'cmd/', 'tools/'))}
assert changed == set(setup['source_sha256'])
for f, expected in setup['source_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, f
    assert (root / f).read_bytes() == (p / 'candidate-source' / f).read_bytes(), f

old = json.loads((root / 'var/posting-json-20261025/production-observed.json').read_text())
live = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'inspect', *[v['name'] for v in old]], text=True))
observed = []
for v in live:
    observed.append({'name': v['Name'].lstrip('/'), 'id': v['Id'], 'image': v['Image'],
                     'started_at': v['State']['StartedAt'],
                     'mounts': [{'type': m['Type'], 'name': m.get('Name'), 'destination': m['Destination']} for m in v['Mounts']]})
for snapshot in [old, observed]:
    for v in snapshot:
        v['mounts'].sort(key=lambda m: m['destination'])
assert observed == old
info = {}
for version, spec in setup['images'].items():
    actual = subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'image', 'inspect', spec['image'], '--format', '{{.Id}}'], text=True).strip()
    assert actual == spec['id'], version
    if version in ['candidate', 'candidate-diag']:
        info[version] = subprocess.check_output(['mise', 'exec', '--', 'go', 'version', '-m', str(p / (version + '-image') / 'oimobbs')], text=True)
(p / 'build-info.json').write_text(json.dumps(info, indent=2))

    ('generated-current', ['mise', 'exec', '--', 'go', 'run', './tools/jsonencodegen', '-check']),
    ('designcheck', ['mise', 'exec', '--', 'python3', 'tools/designcheck/check.py']),

]:

    assert r.returncode == 0, (name, r.stdout, r.stderr)
(p / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps({'checks': checks, 'production_unchanged': True,
                                               'production_observed': observed, 'source_matches_images': True}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
print('VERIFICATION COMPLETE')
